info.title: bConnect Software API
info.description:
Software is a core component of the baramundi Management Suite.

Well known GUIDs: [ Software Bundles: 563AF2FE-2911-4E15-8B1F-55A62BFBED8C ] The bConnect V2 PowerShell module is available from the PowerShell Gallery.

get.summary: Gets all bundle applications contained in a specific software bundle

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
Sorts results by property name and with sort direction. Multiple properties are separated by comma.
Possible values are BundleName, ApplicationName, ApplicationVendor, Order.

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description:
Filters results by matching the given value against searchable properties.
Searchable values are BundleName, ApplicationId, ApplicationName, ApplicationVendor.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The zero-indexed number of the first page that begins the set of pages that are returned in the response.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of items to list on a single page. For example, if page_size is 10, each page shows ten items.
A valid value is a non-negative, non-zero integer. The default value is 20. Maximum value is 1000.

200.description: Returns the bundle applications for the specified bundle id

404.description: A bundle with the specified id does not exist

post.summary: Assigns an application to a bundle

requestBody.description:
Required data to assign an application to a bundle

Initialize in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCSoftwareAddApplicationRequest`

403.description: Missing rights to modify the bundle

404.description: The specified bundle or application can not be found

409.description: The application is already included in the bundle

delete.summary: Deletes a bundle application by id

204.description: Bundle application successfully deleted or does not exist

403.description: Delete rights are missing for bundle object

patch.summary: Replaces an application within a bundle with the specified application

requestBody.description:
A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object.

Initialize patch operations in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCPatchOperation`

400.description: Input data is missing or invalid

403.description: Modify rights are missing for the bundle object

404.description: Either the bundle or the application does not exist or is not visible due to missing read rights

409.description: The application is already included in the bundle or the bundle does not contain the bundle application

post.summary: Creates a folder according to the specified properties

requestBody.description:
The folder to be created

Initialize in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCSoftwareBundleFolderForCreation`

403.description: Object creation rights are missing for parent object

404.description: Either invalid input or the parent of the folder does not exist or is not visible due to missing read rights

409.description: A value was tried to be set twice where duplicates are not allowed

200.description: Returns the folder with the specified id

404.description: A folder with the specified id does not exist

patch.summary: Updates a folder according to the specified properties

requestBody.description:
A JSON Patch document consists of a set of operations that allow specific partial changes to an object. The example document contains all modifiable folder properties.

Initialize patch operations in PowerShell with `Initialize-bCPatchOperation`

400.description: Invalid input or the folder can not be changed

404.description: Either invalid input or the folder does not exist or is not visible due to missing read rights

409.description: A value was tried to be set twice where duplicates are not allowed

400.description: Folder is not empty or can not be deleted

204.description: Folder successfully deleted or does not exist

403.description: Delete rights are missing for folder
